value.description_html:
Located just minutes from downtown Orlando, Dubsdread features the oldest public layout in the area, originally designed in 1923 and renovated in 2008. This classic course has plenty of history attached to it as the former site of the Orlando Open, when it hosted such golf legends as Sam Snead, Ben Hogan and Claude Harmon.

Today, golfers are treated to the same beautiful scenery and challenges of the original course, including narrow fairways and heavily bunkered, "postage stamp" style greens. A full restaurant and banquet facility complete the ultimate golfing experience.
value.information:
**ATTENTION GOLFERS**
The driving range is closed until further notice.

GREAT SPECIAL AVAILABLE TO NON-RESIDENTS AS WELL AS RESIDENTS OF FL!

TAX NOT INCLUDED.

Please bring a copy of your reservation to the golf course. We ask that our customers adhere to golf course dress code: No denim allowed, collared shirt is required, soft spikes only. Players & guests are required to follow all course policies and procedures as outlined by the staff.
value.name: Dubsdread Golf Course

review_summaries.summary: Dubsdread's greens consistently rank among Orlando's best, rolling quick and true even under heavy traffic and wet conditions. Exceptionally friendly staff and fair pricing make this uniquely-laid-out course a standout value in Central Florida.

courses.tee_time_policy:
All golfers must sign a Hold Harmless agreement during the check-in process in order to be permitted to play.
If you wish to cancel your reservation, Dubsdread requires that you do so at least 24 hours before the start of your round. Reservations canceled within this window are subject to being charged the full price for all rounds booked at the discretion of the course.  If you or a member of your party becomes unable to play, you will still be charged for each round of golf you purchased. Not showing for this tee time will result in a charge to your credit card for the entire amount due at the course.

post.description: Expand `has_more_rates` on a `facility_tee_times` row. Without `tee_time_id`, the first tee time of `date` for `players` is used.

date.description: Play date used when `tee_time_id` is omitted, `YYYY-MM-DD` (default tomorrow, UTC). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

players.description:
Players to price for, 1-4 (default 2).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 4.

tee_time_id.description: `tee_time_id` from `facility_tee_times` (may be negative). Omit to use the day's first tee time.

| `greens_fee` | number | Per-player displayed price (site `greensFees`). |
| `holes` | number |  |
| `is_hot_deal` | boolean |  |

| `taxes_and_fees` | number | Site `taxesAndFees` per player; 0 when the site does not itemise them. |

| `transportation` | string |  |
